name: elagoht/client
description: A collage plugin that serves a tiny client script: element getter shorthands, and a fragment put in place by replacing or morphing, fetched from its own URL or handed over as markup.

templateFunctions.name: clientjs
templateFunctions.doc: The collage-client script: `collage.$`, `collage.$$`, `collage.replace`, `collage.morph` and `collage.put`. Put it in the master layout's `<head>`. With a CSP: `{{clientjs cspNonce}}`.
